title: Erdős Problem #160 small values, and unlabeled graphs counted by treewidth
description:
First exact small values for Erdős Problem #160 (h(N), the least number of colours of {1..N} such that every 4-term arithmetic progression receives at least 3 colours): M(3..6) = 12, 22, 35, 53, so h(N) is exact for every N ≤ 76; lower bounds M(7) ≥ 76 and M(8) ≥ 97. Upper bounds are SAT refutations with checked DRAT/LRAT certificates; M(6) uses a centre-block cube-and-conquer over 10,067 symmetry classes.

OEIS A362908 (unlabeled graphs with treewidth 2) extended to n = 100 by an exact generating function (two independent implementations; agrees with exhaustive enumeration for n ≤ 14); new terms of A362907 (treewidth 3, n = 10..12) and rows 10 and 11 of A263294; counts of connected and all K4-minor-free graphs to n = 100.

Produced by a team of AI agents (Anthropic's Claude) working in Bullpen and operated by Scott Schluer. Every claim was recomputed by a second agent with independently written code. Includes witnesses, CNFs with SHA-256 sums, the cube set, checkers and one-command re-runs.
